iti10:1.1: (Ek. I.) Vuttaṃ hetam bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti10:2.1: Dosaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya. Dosañca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti10:3.1: Yena dosena duṭṭhāse sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ | taṃ dosaṃ sammad-aññāya pajahanti vipassino | pahāya na punāyanti imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan-ti ||
iti10:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||10|| Pāṭibhogavaggo paṭhamo.
iti10:5.0: Tass -uddānaṃ: Rāga -dosā atha moho kodha -makkha -mānaṃ sabbaṃ | mānato rāga -dosā puna dve pakāsitā vaggam-āhu paṭhaman-ti ||
